name: Able Coil & Electronics
old_description: Since 1969, Able Coil & Electronics has been a contract manufacturer of custom wire-wound electromagnetic products that require tight tolerances, challenging geometries, high reliability, and stringent environmental requirements.
about:
Able Coil & Electronics was founded in 1969 in Bolton, Connecticut, by Ken Rockefeller to address a growing demand for high-quality coil winding and assembly services. The company remains under Rockefeller family leadership, with Steven Rockefeller serving as president since 2020, when the business expanded into a new state-of-the-art facility alongside its original location, bringing total manufacturing space to more than 40,000 square feet.

The company specializes in custom wire-wound electromagnetic products, including coil assemblies, transformers, encapsulated and toroidal assemblies, fine-wire assemblies, inductors and chokes, cable and connector harnesses, and electro-mechanical assemblies. Its vertically integrated operation covers manual and multi-spindle CNC winding (#4–#56 AWG), automated selective soldering, precision injection over-molding, vacuum pressure impregnation, epoxy and silicone encapsulation, selective conformal coating, and in-house 3D printing and tooling. Testing capabilities include HI-POT up to 20 kV, inductance, capacitance, resistance, impedance, turns ratio, and statistical process control. Annual output reaches millions of components, from prototype to full-scale production.

Able Coil serves aerospace and defense (avionics, satellite communications, radar), commercial and industrial, telecommunications, laser, medical (including imaging equipment), and music and audio markets. Customers range from OEMs requiring mission-critical reliability to commercial programs needing high-volume consistency.

The company differentiates itself through vertical integration that controls design, winding, assembly, and testing under one roof; collaborative engineering support with 3D modeling and rapid prototyping; flexible manufacturing from single units to millions; and a commitment to tight tolerances, complex geometries, and stringent environmental requirements without compromise.

name: Absolute Electronics
old_description: Absolute PCB Assembly specializes in custom PCB Assembly services, tailoring our processes to meet the unique specifications and demands of each client. Our commitment to excellence ensures the delivery of high-quality electronic devices.
about:
Absolute Electronics Services, based in Addison, Illinois, has provided PCB assembly solutions since 1995. The company operates as a contract manufacturer serving a range of electronics sectors from its single Midwest location.

Its core offering centers on printed circuit board assembly using automated surface-mount and through-hole lines, with capabilities that include BGA placement, flexible circuit assembly, conformal coating, and rework and repair. Beyond bare-board assembly, the shop provides wire and cable harness fabrication, box-build integration, mechanical and electromechanical assembly, and full turnkey procurement alongside kitted or consigned material models. Inspection relies on automated optical inspection (AOI), 3D X-ray, in-circuit test, and functional test.

The customer base spans industrial equipment, LED lighting, RF/IoT/M2M, automotive, medical, telecommunications, and consumer electronics. Testimonials reference an industrial electronics manufacturer (Tescor Products LLC), a telecom manufacturer, and a consumer electronics manufacturer.

The company highlights its ITAR-registered, U.S.-based facility as a supply-chain security advantage, promising turnkey execution under one roof and lead times as short as 48 hours. Its stated differentiators also include military-grade inspection technology and domestic customer support from Addison.

name: Accent Woodworking Inc.
old_description: Established in 1998, Accent Woodworking Inc. has been making standard and custom wood furniture & cabinetry for both residential and commercial properties throughout Florida. We pride ourselves on using local American-made lumber to create high quality products with various wood species. At Accent Woodworking Inc., we build and design kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, laundry room cabinets, custom built-ins, Murphy wall beds, home office furniture, entertainment centers & much more!
about:
Accent Woodworking Inc. was founded in 1998 by Rick and Janet Carnevali in Largo, Florida. Rick Carnevali began his career in high school at a cabinet shop in Raritan, New Jersey, and brought that lifelong passion for hand‑crafted wood furniture to the Tampa Bay area. The company remains a family‑owned and operated business.

The shop produces custom wood furniture and cabinetry entirely in‑house, using solid domestic hardwoods such as oak, maple, walnut, and ash, along with plywood veneers—no particleboard or pressboard. Products range from kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and laundry room cabinets to Murphy wall beds, home office furniture, entertainment centers, built‑ins, closet systems, and guitar cabinets. The team works in traditional, Mission/Shaker, modern, contemporary, and shiplap styles, offering more than ten standard finishes plus custom color matching. All pieces are delivered fully assembled to customers in Pinellas, Pasco, Hillsborough, Manatee, and Polk counties; the company does not ship.

Accent serves residential homeowners, interior designers, builders, and commercial clients including medical offices, churches, boutiques, and retail stores throughout its five‑county service area. Projects are built‑to‑order, with free in‑home consultations for local residents and Zoom consultations available on request.

The founders’ stated mission is to combine quality craftsmanship with affordability while providing excellent service. The company emphasizes a collaborative design process, personal attention from sketch to installation, and a satisfaction guarantee on every piece.

name: Ace Electronics
old_description: Since our inception in 1978, Ace Electronics has earned the position as the leading provider of state-of-the-art, customized cable assembly solutions. Our expertise encompasses multiple industries from Defense and General Industry to Robotics and Automation.
about:
Ace Electronics was founded in 1978 in Metuchen, New Jersey, and operates as a service‑disabled veteran‑owned small business (SDVOSB) with additional woman‑owned small business (WOSB) and small business (SB) designations. The company began as a provider of customized cable assembly solutions and has expanded to three U.S. locations: Metuchen, NJ; Aberdeen Proving Ground, MD; and Troy, MI.

The company functions as a contract manufacturer specializing in wire harnesses, custom cable assemblies, electro‑mechanical box builds, and injection‑molded components. Its engineering services support design through production, and all manufacturing personnel are certified to IPC/WHMA‑A‑620 standards. Facilities across the three sites hold distinct CAGE codes (7Y943, 5TWH2, 6BXZ9) and maintain ITAR registration for defense work.

Ace Electronics serves defense, aerospace, robotics/industrial, medical, and rail sectors. Prime contractors such as BAE Systems and Lockheed Martin have recognized the firm with Partner 2 Win Gold and Silver Tier awards and an Exceptional Small Business Award, respectively. The company also holds a position on the Missile Defense Agency’s SHIELD IDIQ contract vehicle with a $151 billion ceiling.

Leadership emphasizes a warfighter‑focused approach, citing longevity, certified staff, and a commitment to listening to client requirements as differentiators. The firm highlights its ability to deliver customized interconnect solutions across multiple vehicle platforms while maintaining ISO 9001:2015 quality management.

old_description: Ace Wire & Cable Co., Inc. was founded in 1952 and has been owned and operated by three generations of the Firestone family. Ace’s mission is to be the number one wire, cable, and connectivity product distributor in the Northeast region, serving New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and southern Connecticut
about:
Ace Wire & Cable Co., Inc. was founded in 1952 by Jack Firestone in the New York metropolitan area. The business has remained in the Firestone family for three generations, with Jerry and Harris Firestone directly involved in daily operations. Headquartered in Avenel, New Jersey, with a second location in Woodside, Queens, the company serves the Northeast region including New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and southern Connecticut.

The company operates as a master stocking distributor of wire, cable, and connectivity products for power, voice, data, video, security, building wire, and fire alarm applications. It maintains a 30,000-square-foot warehouse in Avenel and a facility in Woodside, staffed by approximately 75 employees. Value-added services performed in-house at both locations include cutting, striping, and paralleling of cable, supported by a fleet of heavy-duty tailgate trucks for delivery.

Ace Wire & Cable supplies contractors, installers, system integrators, OEMs, and end users across commercial, industrial, and institutional projects. Its product range covers building wiring systems, data communications, video, power, fire alarm, security, and industrial products. The company emphasizes a simplex purchasing process and logistics programs designed to support customers from project proposal through completion.

The firm differentiates itself by keeping essential services in-house rather than outsourcing, a practice it says ensures personalized, professional customer service with access to knowledgeable technical support. Membership in Local Union No. 3 of the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers Supply Division reflects its longstanding ties to the electrical trade.

name: Achtuning
old_description: Since 1978, Hartmann Wheels has focused on bringing the highest quality wheels to the US market. Hartmann wheels are designed by Germany's finest engineers and produced in a modern, state-of-the-art German owned foundry. Hartmann utilizes a low pressure casting process which produces a high performance wheel equal in strength and finish quality to OEM Audi and VW wheels. The wheels are heat treated for increased strength and are tested to JWL, VIA, and TUV standards.
about:
Achtuning operates from a 27,000-square-foot facility in Redmond, Washington, just east of Seattle. The business was founded in 2001 by Joshua Decker and Ben Moses, starting with a single shift knob imported from Germany and sold online. Decker, who began his German-car journey with a 1986 VW Jetta GLI, expanded the catalog to include turbos and complete RS4 body kits before selling the company in 2006 to Bill Spencer, owner of Hartmann Wheels, a brand that has supplied the U.S. market since 1978. Spencer, a three-decade veteran of German-car tuning, now owns and directs Achtuning.

The company specializes in the distribution and installation of performance parts for Audi, Volkswagen, BMW, and Porsche vehicles. As an authorized distributor for brands including APR, Centric Parts, Girodisc, H&R, Hartmann Wheels, and StopTech, Achtuning stocks a high volume of inventory on site for immediate shipment or installation. The Redmond facility houses offices, a retail showroom, a main warehouse, and a seven-lift installation bay. A staff of ten, each of whom owns and works on German cars, handles everything from basic oil changes to brake service, scheduled maintenance, and full performance builds.

Achtuning serves the European car enthusiast community through its physical storefront and an international location in Korea. The company sponsors regional events and online forums such as Audizine, QuattroWorld, and VWVortex, and is a proud sponsor of Audi Club Northwest, the largest Audi enthusiast group in the Pacific Northwest. Customers range from individual owners seeking maintenance or upgrades to shops sourcing OEM-quality components.

The business distinguishes itself by maintaining deep stock levels — 40,000 square feet of storage by one account — and by testing parts on its own vehicles, both street and track, before offering them for sale. As an authorized distributor, Achtuning guarantees genuine products without knockoffs or factory “B-Stock,” backed by manufacturer technical support.

name: Aco Inc
old_description: In the heart of Oklahoma City, ACO, Inc., a family-owned innovator since 1972, leads a legacy of craftsmanship and commitment in the polymer industry. With a dynamic blend of proprietary technology, a resilient work ethic spanning three generations, and an unwavering dedication to customer satisfaction, ACO, Inc. shapes ideas into reality within its bustling 90,000 square foot facility.
about:
ACO, Inc. operates from a 90,000-square-foot facility in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company was founded in 1972 by Jerry Asner and remains a family-owned business now in its third generation, led by President David Asner, CFO Esther Stephenson, and VP Operations Andrew Feiler.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding and tooling, running 20 molding machines that include proprietary structural foam equipment capable of producing parts up to six feet cubed or 250 pounds. ACO provides a full turnkey operation: free consultation, part design, prototyping, tooling built and maintained in its on-site tool and die shop, CNC machining, CAD drafting, secondary operations, assembly, finishing (engraving, hot stamping, metal forming, bending, sonic welding), and custom jigs and fixtures. It handles small to large batch production runs and stores tooling for the life of each project.

ACO serves customers across a broad range of industries, leveraging its ability to process a wide variety of engineering-grade materials including polyethylene (HDPE, LDPE), polypropylene, ABS, polycarbonate, PPS, nylon, PVC, and specialty alloys such as Static Intercept, Corrosion Intercept, Carmelstat, Noryl, Santoprene, Pelethane, and Durethane.

The company emphasizes its family-owned culture, low employee turnover, and Oklahoma work ethic as differentiators. It guarantees tooling storage for the life of a project, offers one-on-one communication, and aims for faster turnaround times through its integrated in-house workflow.

name: Acton Custom Enterprises, LLC
old_description: Graduating from Granite State College with a bachelor's degree in Behavioral Science, she worked for the Department of Corrections for many years. Bonni has been a school board member since 2009 and has been vice president of PTO when their kids were younger.
about:
Acton Custom Enterprises, LLC operates from Holderness, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 2008 by Nick and Bonni Acton. Nick, a native of New Zealand with degrees in mechanical and production engineering, had spent a lifetime modifying and racing cars before a stint with Camp Counselors USA brought him to the Lakes Region. He met Bonni in 1993, and their shared automotive passion evolved from a hobby into a family-owned specialty shop. Bonni, a former corrections officer and school board member, manages the office and operates shop machinery, while their sons Vance and Carl assist with fabrication and sandblasting.

The company manufactures nearly 500 catalog parts across 29 categories and provides custom fabrication services from a facility equipped with a CNC plasma table, Bridgeport mill, lathe, hydraulic press, tube bender, English wheel, and welding equipment for TIG, MIG, stick, and aluminum. Core activities include scratch-building replica cars, restoring original Cobras, completing unfinished projects, and producing historically accurate components such as custom oil pans, cold-air boxes, and programmed dash panels. The shop also offers worldwide pre-purchase inspections, authentication of original Cobras, and on-site restoration travel.

Acton Custom serves the Cobra replica and classic-car restoration market, supplying parts to restoration experts and selling vehicles internationally. Customers range from individual enthusiasts seeking a custom-built replica to collectors requiring verification of originality. The business has shipped products and provided consulting services globally.

The founders emphasize old-world craftsmanship and exacting attention to detail, rooted in Nick’s engineering background and hands-on approach. The company differentiates itself by offering historically accurate details, custom solutions for tall drivers, and the ability to fabricate parts that do not yet exist, all produced in the United States.

Adaptive Technologies Inc. (ATI) was founded in 2001 in Nampa, Idaho, and operates as an owner-operated plastic injection molding company. The business is backed by the owner’s decades of hands-on experience in part functionality, moldability, and patent considerations.

ATI provides in-house part design, CAD modeling, and prototyping services alongside mold design and plastic injection molding. The facility runs nine injection molding machines with clamp tonnage ranging from 85 to 500 tons and shot capacity up to 72 ounces, supporting projects from first articles through full production runs. A fully equipped quality department verifies parts against detailed written and visual instructions.

The company serves a broad range of industries including construction, electronics, food and beverage, firearms, sports and outdoors, agricultural, medical, consumer, transportation, and automotive.

ATI emphasizes its owner’s deep industry experience—nearly 50 years—as a differentiator, offering insight into part design for manufacturability and assisting customers in transitioning concepts into production-ready components.
